name: Okazaki Castle
description: Okazaki Castle is the birthplace of Tokugawa Ieyasu (1542), built by his grandfather's generation of the Matsudaira clan. The 1959-reconstructed keep overlooks the Yahagi river; the grounds are a famous cherry-blossom park.
notes: Keep admission ¥360 adult; the adjacent Okazaki Castle Museum interprets Ieyasu's origins.
